text:
Priya A.: Heads-up — offer accepted for Sofia (Sr. Data Engineer) with 2026-04-01 start. Payroll in her country (PT) has a cutoff 3/29 so first regular salary will be delayed until 4/30. We need approval for a temporary arrangement: frontload a one-time onboarding advance (taxable) of 50% of monthly base to be paid within first payroll window, plus a provisional comp-band uplift of +1 band for 3 months to match market while relocation is processed. Requesting routing/approval and tax guidance. /cc @Ruth (People Ops) @Leo

Evan G.: thx priya. can we split it as 50% advance and remaining 50% in first regular pay? also need to confirm with finance if advance should be on the offer or processed as a separate expense.

Priya A.: yes that's the ask. Offer doc already reflects base and sign-on. We want the advance instead of sign-on to avoid deferred bonus complexities. Will update offer if approved.

Ruth (People Ops): tagging finance payroll team, but quick flags: 1) cross-border payroll advances often trigger withholding differences, 2) temporary band uplift needs exec sponsor and 1-month review cadence to revert, 3) we should decide if advance is recoverable if candidate leaves within 3 months. do we want clawback?

Leo (Hiring Manager): We can commit to 3-month tenure before clawback. Hiring team is comfortable. Exec sponsor: Leo (me) ok to sign off on uplift for 3 months.

Evan G.: finance note: @PeopleOpsBot can you run standard payroll-impact calc for Portugal (PT) and attach estimated withholding + grossup if needed?

PeopleOpsBot: payroll-impact-calc started for country=PT amount=50%monthly. Results: est employer withholding diff ~4.2% gross; net advance after withholding est 46% of monthly. (See /docs/payroll/pt-advances.md)

Ruth (People Ops): thanks bot. two decisions needed for approvals flow: - approve one-time onboarding advance (50% monthly) - approve temporary +1 band for 3 months with 1-month quality review and clawback window. I'll route to compensation committee and finance. Please confirm clawback language: "advance repayable if employment terminated within 90 days".

Priya A.: confirmed. add to offer: "Onboarding advance of 50% of first month payable within payroll window; repayable if employment terminates within 90 days." Also include uplift term: "Temporary comp band uplift for 90 days subject to manager review; will revert automatically."

Evan G.: putting together packet for comp committee: candidate details, market comp comps, rationale for uplift, payroll calc, proposed clawback clause. ETA 2 hours.

Ruth (People Ops): routed to comp committee (cc:comp-committee). Please review. If approved by committee and finance, People Ops will send updated offer and payroll will process advance. I'll log decision in GDrive: /hr/onboarding-exceptions/2026/sofia-pt-advance.docx

Leo (Hiring Manager): thanks team — major priority to keep candidate start date. :party-parrot:

Priya A.: appreciate fast turnaround. will standby for committee reply and updated offer template to send tonight. :pray:
